description: This file defines a React component for the user registration page, handling form inputs, validation, password strength checking, and registration request logic.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: React component class that manages user registration, including form inputs, password validation, and submission.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: handlePasswordChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the password input, calculates password strength score.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates the state with the confirmation password.

methods.name: checkPasswordsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the password and confirmation password match.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the email input field.

methods.name: onCreateAccountClicked
methods.description: Validates input fields and submits registration request if valid.

methods.name: sendRegisterRequest
methods.description: Performs the API call to register the new user.

methods.name: isEmailInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the email input is invalid for display.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the password input is invalid for display.

methods.name: renderServerError
methods.description: Renders an error message if server registration fails.

methods.name: renderPasswordError
methods.description: Renders an error message if password strength validation fails.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render method for the registration form and UI components.
